pairs.note: Answer gives only the bare label 'master-feeder'. It omits required elements from the key: open-end with monthly redemptions, the Delaware feeder, the Cayman master fund (Quillmarsh Global Macro Master Fund, Ltd.) into which substantially all assets are invested, and the parallel offshore feeder. Substantially incomplete rather than merely less detailed.

Key requires two auditor appointments - Marbeck Pennycott LLP for the Fund and Marbeck Pennycott (Cayman) for the Master Fund. Answer names only the Fund-level auditor and drops the Master Fund auditor, a missing required element (one of two). The firm name is also misspelled ('Pennyott' for 'Pennycott'), which alone would be a minor variance but compounds the omission.
